name: corvint-vscode
description: Local, revision-pinned Corvint evidence for Visual Studio Code.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Corvint V0 requires a trusted local file workspace and a separately installed executable in the workspace extension host.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Corvint execution, discovery, configuration-path access, repository reads, and observation import are disabled until the workspace is trusted.

enumDescriptions: Invoke a separately installed corvint executable directly.
Invoke a separately installed corvint-mcp executable over local MCP 2026-07-28 stdio.
corvint.transport.description: Explicit local Corvint transport. The extension never falls back between transports.

corvint.executablePath.description: Absolute path to a corvint candidate, used only by the cli transport. It is never executed until explicitly pinned in a trusted workspace.

corvint.mcpExecutablePath.description: Absolute path to a corvint-mcp candidate, used only by the mcp-stdio transport. No PATH discovery, network transport, or automatic install is performed.

corvint.testObservationPath.description: Workspace-relative path to a local Corvint go-live-event/0 NDJSON observation. Import is always explicit.

corvint.maxOutputBytes.description: Maximum stdout bytes accepted from one Corvint command; stderr has an independent fixed 65,536-byte bound.

corvint.timeoutMilliseconds.description: Hard timeout for an explicitly requested Corvint command.

corvint.liveTests.enabled.description: Explicitly enable the configured local test provider in this trusted workspace. JS unit/E2E providers rerun on eligible editor saves.

corvint.liveTests.command.description: Provider executable followed by literal arguments (no shell). Use an absolute Corvint (or legacy) JS unit/E2E or Go session provider command. Project test tooling is required.

corvint.liveTests.retainEvidence.description: Ask a supported provider to retain bounded local evidence for agent/MCP discovery in .corvint/test-evidence.

corvint.liveTests.watchPaths.description: Repository-relative files/directories whose editor saves rerun the configured full JS unit/E2E suite. Build, dependency and Corvint/Git state directories are excluded; external filesystem edits do not trigger this alpha profile.

corvint.liveTests.toolchainPaths.description: Explicit absolute directories containing project Node/npm/Go tools, prepended only to the enabled live provider PATH. For example /opt/homebrew/bin. No other environment is inherited.

view/title.when: view == corvint.evidence || view == corvint.impact || view == corvint.why
view == corvint.evidence || view == corvint.impact || view == corvint.why

scripts.check: npm run deps && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
